data.title: Order to cut back your hedge (Landratsamt Beispielkreis)
data.summary: The Landratsamt Beispielkreis ordered Jonas Mustermann on 29 June 2026 to cut back a hedge that reaches up to 1.20 m into the pavement beside county road RO 5. The order can be challenged with an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office says your hedge sticks out up to 1.20 m over the pavement and blocks visibility at the junction. You must cut it back to your property line. You may accept the order or file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the office named in the letter. The app shows the objection deadline. The cut-back is requested within three weeks after the order becomes final (Bestandskraft), which normally happens once the objection period passes without an objection. If you disagree, or are unsure, consider getting legal advice before the deadline.

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or on record at the Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau.
items.consequence: Without an objection in time, the order becomes final (Bestandskraft) and must be complied with.
